_about: Register of everything the car must answer (package CA of docs/AGENT-BRIEF-car-signals.md). Kinds: L = read a log the installed apps already write; P = a signal read by the probe; X = an experiment (a build or a setting, then a photo or a log); F = a photo or an observation. status: open | answered | partly-answered | needs-lead-decision | needs-owner-approval | out-of-session. evidence: arrives | arrives-other-app | not sent | unseen | n/a. in_brief: as-is | corrected | new (relative to §3 of the brief). fields: '<Interface>.<field>[@instance]' resolved against the catalogue by tools/car/check_register.py (design/car/register_fields.json). Numbers, enum names and lengths only; no text, no coordinate.

items.title: Why f30's window over BMW's panel stays open
items.question: Which of cases A1-A17 holds on the car: does the window stay open after BMW's message has gone, and why.
items.steps: Read f30_cluster.log (+ .1) and settings.json (hudLayout, g20, bottomRow). grep -E 'active cc:|check-control (list|message|frames):|displayed cc:|bottom row:|probe: ccList'. Apply the 13-row table of MC §6. Trap: 'no ccList entry for number N' alone is written once per N and does not prove a hang (row 5).
items.decides: which config.ccActive.release set (deferValues / leftList / witness) and ccm.clearIds to ship; whether the owner's hang was in an opaque theme or a G20 file with BMW's row (H5)
items.note: SC (branch twin-r3/sc, SC-REPORT.md §4.7, §8 item 5) narrows MC's leftList: do NOT switch on f30's 'rec' until _ccRelease carries the narrowing (C8). The log lines 'active cc: released to the list' exist only on main (not on the car). No f30 log later than 0.7.12 is saved on the Mac.

items.question: Does KombiIF.statusActiveCCMessage send anything on this car; its rest value (0, 65535 or the last number); does its number equal the ccList id; what 'control' and 'utility' carry.
items.steps: grep 'active cc: number'. The 0.7.20 line is 'active cc: number N control C frame F/G utility U', once per change. Compare N with the id on 'check-control list:' lines in the same minute.

items.question: Does Vehicle.statusDayNightChangeOver arrive; what does 0 (KEINE_AENDERUNG) mean in practice; the car's verdict against the sun.

items.title: Which message the cluster shows now
items.question: Is KombiIF.statusActiveCCMessage's number the ccList id while a message shows, and 0 when BMW hides it; do statusDisplayedCCMessage and statusMenuCCMessage (frame n of m) agree; what does ccList hold at rest.

items.decides: 'shown now' = the list id; the rest value; the frame counter; D7 lift (config.ccActive.strict false = the owner's decision); f30 release
items.note: Subscribed already by the installed Twin Dial 0.1.0 (statusActiveCCMessage, statusMenuCCMessage, statusDisplayedCCMessage, ccList) and by f30 0.7.20 (all but the witness). L1/L2/L8 read it from those logs first; P1 is then only needed for the paired presses (two doors) and a clean marker.

items.title: The stored-message marker, risk class
items.question: Which signal marks BMW's small 'i' / triangle marker (stored messages): CheckControlMaster.basicList activeState / reason, or ccListRiskClass (RK10-RK900 as a severity sort key).
items.steps: After reading the 0.7.18 lines (L13): repeat P1's door message and PHOTOGRAPH BMW's marker (visible / not) at the time of each log read; one photo with only a stored message (ready-to-drive) and one with a stored door warning.

items.title: Odometer carriers
items.question: Which carrier gives the odometer in km, what is its invalid value; factor 1?
items.steps: Ignition on: read the cluster's odometer (photo of the cluster or iDrive's vehicle info page); engine off and on once more.
items.decides: config.odometer.factors / order; whether the three extra carriers are needed
items.note: Answered first by L5 if mileageKilometre arrives (Twin Dial 0.1.0 already reads it).

items.title: The trip computer
items.question: Factors of speed / consumption / distance; which counter (BC1 or BC2) is 'since start'; the departure time and whether it is UTC or local; the ResetLogic generation behind iDrive's trip page.
items.steps: After a drive of at least 3 minutes and 2 km, parked, engine on: photograph iDrive's trip computer page (both counters); open Twin Dial's trip page (centre = trip); photograph it. Optionally reset the trip in iDrive and watch wayPassed fall (we never reset). MK-PROTOCOL.md is the five-minute version.
items.decides: config.trip.factors (bc, speed, cons, way, rl3), departureUtc, order, verified
items.note: Answered first by L4 for the three KombiIF fields.

items.title: Units
items.question: Kilometres or miles, Celsius or Fahrenheit, bar or psi on this car; the scale of the cluster's outside temperature and range.
items.steps: Read once after ignition on; note what the cluster shows beside outside= / range= (the scale is read off the pair).
items.decides: the mph / mile variant is or is not needed; temperature and pressure units
items.note: Also in 0.1.0's log: 'units raw (P5): mileage <value> (round 2 shows km)' (once). NOTE: the 0.7.12 f30 log shows the platform's own CurrentVehicleUnits failing ('envInfoProxy ... Cannot read property getValue/subscribe of undefined', f30_cluster-0712.log lines 19-24, 1241-1245) although f30 declares EnvironmentalInformation.ExteriorTemperature: that is the SDK's proxy, not evidence about UnitBN2020.

items.title: Coolant verdict
items.question: The car's own COLD / OK / HOT / STRICHE verdict against the raw coolant temperature.
items.steps: Cold engine (parked for hours): ignition on, start, idle or drive gently 10-15 minutes; note the t of COLD -> OK and the coolant value either side.
items.decides: config.coolant.coldC / hotC (bar empty point, red segment)
items.answer: The coolant RAW value arrives and decodes as raw - 48 C (car_vitals 'engine temperatures: [126,123]' -> 78 C; verified in f30). Only the car's own verdict (dataInstrumentPack) is unseen.
items.note: The brief says 'the car's own coolant verdict'; the scale itself is answered.

items.title: Doors, boot, bonnet, central locking
items.question: Do the notifier-only door fields notify at all; does any send once at subscribe (so the car picture can start from 'open' rather than 'unknown').
items.steps: Engine off, ignition on. Open and close ONE at a time, 3 s between each: driver, front passenger, rear left, rear right, boot, bonnet (a passenger does the bonnet).
items.decides: the table door -> field -> open-value; whether the car picture (SV V2) is possible
items.note: CentralLockingSystemAndPanelStatus2 is notifier-only ('s'): nothing arrives until something changes.

items.title: Media and radio
items.question: Does HmiMediaState notify and which line is the title / artist / station; progress and its unit; the source's icon kind; the radio detail (band, RT+, preset); the CarPlay player; is the unit ticking.
items.steps: Engine on, parked, ~30 s per step: FM (then a second station; open the station list once); DAB; USB (play, pause 10 s, play, skip twice); Bluetooth audio (same); CarPlay (same, then open a playlist on the phone); change source with the wheel button through all sources; mute and unmute. For each step count the characters of the title and the artist shown on the centre screen.
items.decides: config.media.titleLine / sourceTypes; M1 / M2 / M3; tab 3 text; the progress unit (10000 -> ms)
items.note: 13 fields: main has playerMetadata, activeSourceId, sources; SM adds 10 (trackProgress, mainMenuMetadata, menu, currentStationFmDabAm, five MediaPlayer, listOfMainConnections). If the owner uses Android Auto, MediaPlayer@CarPlayMedia is swapped for AndroidAutoProjectedMediaPlayer (SM §7.4, D5). Mute needs an event (P21).

items.title: Phone
items.question: States of a call (INCOMING / ACTIVE / DIALING / HELD / DISCONNECTED); per-call state, duration, whether a contact is known (and the name's length); device battery / signal / roles; missed calls; is `Telephone` the car's own modem (silent during a phone call); CarPlay calls; whether BMW's ringing pad stays visible with Twin Dial on.
items.steps: SP §5.1, steps 0-7: no phone, then Bluetooth only; ring from a SAVED contact (10 s, answer, 40 s, mute and unmute, hang up) with a PHOTO of the cluster while it rings (Twin Dial on, then once with it off); ring from an UNSAVED number and do not answer (wait 30 s); dial out from iDrive's call list; open the phone menu and leave; the phone on the wireless tray 30 s; CarPlay (or Android Auto) repeat 2 and 3. Use a second phone to ring the car.
items.decides: A1 (tab icon lit + call card with our own timer); the name setting; signal bars; whether Twin Dial hides BMW's call pop-up (raises the card's priority); a missed-call count
items.note: CORRECTION: 33 fields = aggregatedCallState (main) + CarPlayManager.projectedTelephonyActive (main) + SP's 31 (the brief says 32). The brief's table omits two steps: the phone on the wireless tray (WCAStatus, wcaNfcFrontStatus) and opening the phone menu (HMIContext.currentActiveApplication). Telephone has two instances (1, 2); the probe watches the first; Call2 is not watched (SP §10).

items.title: Battery voltage
items.question: Is there a plausible 12-14.8 V reading; scale of the voltage member (hypothesis 0.01-0.05 V/bit) and of the head unit's supply (mV).
items.steps: Ignition on, engine off: read; start the engine: read; switch off: read. A voltmeter value for each state if available.
items.decides: config.battery = {field, factor}; whether a battery readout exists

items.title: The cluster's view and the map-view setting
